question: Each of I, J, K, L, U, V and W has an exam on a different day of a week starting from Monday and ending on Sunday of the same week.J has the exam on Friday. Only two people have the exam between V and J. Only four people have the exam between L and V. U has the exam immediately after W. K does not have the exam on Monday.How many people have the exam before K and after I?
solution:
Each of I, J, K, L, U, V and W has an exam on a different day of a week starting from Monday and ending on Sunday of the same week.

1. J has the exam on Friday.

2. Only two people have the exam between V and J.

3. Only four people have the exam between L and V.

4. U has the exam immediately after W.

5. K does not have the exam on Monday.

Four people have the exam before K and after I.

Hence, the correct answer is “Option 2**”.
